name: EntitlementReceived
summary: The `entitlementsReceived` member body of the Entitlement replicated state: one strict zero-or-one byte. The client's reader refuses any other value, so the card declares bool_byte and the codec refuses a byte above 1 instead of reading it as true.
purpose: Name the member layout that the two-level presence mask selects (group 0 member 2 of codec.entitlement-replicated-state).

fields.name: received
fields.note: One raw byte read by 0x1417b4c20 through FUN_1408787b0; the reader stores it only when it is below 2 and otherwise fails. Measured 1. The field's meaning is inferred from the member name and is NOT proven, so its meaning stays layout-only.

evidence.ref: research/fixtures/wire/state-fragment-3133.hex: the final byte is 01; byte-exact round trip.
